icd_linked.llm_icd_reason: Mapped code at matched rank is D53.9 (Nutritional anemia, unspecified), whereas the billed primary is D50.9 (Iron deficiency anemia, unspecified). Although both fall in the nutritional anemia block (D50-D53), they designate different anemia etiologies/morphologies — iron deficiency anemia is characteristically microcytic while D53.9 covers unspecified nutritional (including macrocytic/megaloblastic-type) anemia — so a coder would not treat them as interchangeable for the principal diagnosis.
